title: The ID Stack
summary: Why identical labels collide, ## and ### labels, PushID/PopID in loops, GetID, and debugging with the ID Stack Tool. Essential for every entity list and inspector.

quiz.q: A loop creates Button("Select") for every entity in one window. What is wrong?
options: All buttons share one ID, so clicks go to the wrong row
Only the last button is drawn
quiz.explain: The ID is hash(ID stack + label). Same window + same label = same ID. Wrap the loop body in PushID(i)/PopID().
Text after ## is hashed into the ID but not displayed.

quiz.q: Your window title is "Inspector - %s" with the selected entity name, and the window jumps every time the selection changes. Fix?
quiz.explain: With ### only the part after it forms the ID, so the window keeps its identity, position and size.

quiz.q: Why is a permanent entity UID better than the loop index for PushID?
options: Deleting or reordering entities doesn't move UI state (open nodes, active fields) to a different entity
quiz.explain: Index IDs follow the row position. A stable UID follows the object itself.
